name: Dr. K A Mohan
description:
Dr. K A Mohan is a Dentist and Orthodontist in Domlur 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bangalore and has an experience of 47 years in these fields. Dr. K A Mohan practices at Dental DeCare, Indiranagar & Koramangala 3 Block, Bangalore. He completed BDS from Govt. Dental College and Research Institute, Bangalore in 1969 and MDS - Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics from Govt. Dental College and Research Institute, Bangalore in 1977.

He is a member of Karnataka State Dental Council, Indian Orthodontic Society and Indian Dental Association.

review.reviewBody: Dr. K A Mohan gave me an extensive consultation, listened carefully to all my questions, and explained every detail about my condition and treatment plan. The clinic was very clean, the staff were prompt and helpful, and I felt it was excellent value for my time and money.

This is my 1st visit to Dr.Mohan & Dr. Pramod for tooth extraction. As an individual I had a lot of anxiety, apprehensions etc about the process, treatment, recovery etc.
I must say with 100 % assurance that the overall experience was excellent.  Both Uncle Dr .Mohan and Dr.Pramod explained the situation very well, most importantly made me feel extremely relaxed and completed the procedure as per planned timelines.
This is a place I would highly recommend!  5/5 to me

Good clarity in explaining the problem and the pros and cons. Further left his brief and dwelt into the importance and care a child needs to give to dental care to have a better adulthood from dental point of view.
At time I thought am I interacting with a Dental Dr or a Professor who is addressing his students. 

In a nutshell was a pleasant and pleasurable experience.

I visited the dentist with tooth discomfort and received a quick diagnosis of a wisdom tooth that needed extraction. The procedure took less than 10 minutes the next day, and I was given clear instructions for post-extraction care. Despite my initial apprehension, I experienced no pain throughout the process or afterwards* *** ******** ********** efficient procedure, and effective medication made the experience much better than expected. I'll definitely return for future concerns.

mainEntity.name: Which treatments are given by an orthodontist?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The orthodontist specialises in the following treatments:
 ·Straightening of crooked teeth
 ·Alignment of misaligned teeth
 ·Bad bites (difficulty in chewing due to teeth alignment)
 ·Correct problems during facial growth and development
 ·Treat dental problems in all ages children, teens and adults

mainEntity.name: Can an orthodontist perform surgery on my teeth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orthodontists can carry out the removal of teeth or surgical removal of wisdom tooth. However, he does not play a direct role in surgery. He is responsible for an initial evaluation, pre-surgical orthodontics, planning of the surgery and post-surgical care along with the surgeon who actually performs the surgery.
